findings.description: append_batch appends elements before detecting a negative value, so a negative value after some positives leaves the store partially mutated, which is disallowed by the contract.
findings.evidence: If store = [1] and values = [2, -1], candidate.append_batch will append 2 to store, then raise ValueError, leaving store as [1, 2] instead of [1] as required.

review.summary: Candidate append_batch does not guarantee atomicity: it appends values before encountering a negative, violating the specification that the store must remain unchanged if any value is negative.
